notes: This website is for Laurel Tavern in Studio City, CA (11938 Ventura Blvd), not the Dallas location at 1920 Greenville Ave. Its happy hour (Mon-Fri 3-6pm, $7 beer, $9 wine/cocktails, $3 fish tacos) applies to the California location, so it was skipped.
